images.label: StreetCornerAmbush
images.prompt: A rain-slicked urban street corner at night, neon signs flicker weakly in the distance, casting violet and cyan reflections on wet asphalt. A woman in a wind-blown coat stands frozen, staring into deep shadow where a tall figure in a tattered black hooded cloak emerges—face obscured by an ornate silver mask, eyes glowing faintly amber. Low-angle composition, cinematic depth of field, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with stark contrast between cold ambient glow and warm emergency-light spill from a distant café. Cyberpunk style, hyper-detailed textures, moody atmospheric haze.

images.label: OccultApartmentClue
images.prompt: Dim, claustrophobic interior of a run-down apartment: peeling wallpaper, overturned furniture, and occult symbols drawn in chalk and dried ink on cracked plaster walls. A flashlight beam cuts diagonally across the frame, illuminating floating dust and a close-up of a trembling hand holding a torn, aged map covered in alchemical sigils and cryptic coordinates. Shallow depth of field, high-contrast noir lighting with deep shadows pooling in corners. Sci-fi thriller style, realistic rendering, gritty film grain, muted desaturated palette punctuated by faint bioluminescent glyphs pulsing softly on the wall.

images.label: AbandonedChurchMap
images.prompt: An abandoned neo-gothic church at twilight—broken stained-glass windows cast fractured colored light onto crumbling stone floors. In the center, a lone detective kneels beside a rusted iron lectern holding an open journal with glowing circuit-like ink sketches. Faint holographic projections of shifting constellations and binary glyphs hover mid-air. Wide shot with symmetrical composition, volumetric fog, cool blue-violet ambient light mixed with eerie green data-glow accents. Anime-style sci-fi aesthetic, sharp linework, luminous detail, atmospheric perspective, subtle lens flare.
